title: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
abstract: arXiv:2610.06411v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, replayed under fixed temporal cutoffs. Both routes produced valid structures: LLM proposals stayed closer to local chemistry and reached comparable or higher primary activity in fewer operations, whereas REINVENT explored broader chemical space. Whether a campaign met its objective depended on the predictive models, not on the generation route: attainment follo

translated_title: 从基准测试到实验台：智能体能否在真实世界的药物研发中存活？
translated_abstract: 智能体系统越来越多地被用于协调分子设计工具，但尚不清楚技术栈中的哪一层限制了真实项目上的结果。我们开发了MAGI，一个开源的模块化智能体，它能够撰写优化目标、启动并监控优化过程、解读构效关系，并据此调整自身策略。MAGI既可以直接通过大语言模型生成分子，也可以将任务委托给REINVENT 4，同时评分服务在统一接口约定下可互换。我们在来自三家制药公司的九项回顾性先导化合物优化项目上对其进行了测试，这些项目在固定的时间截点下重放。两种生成都产生了有效的分子结构：大语言模型提出的分子更贴近局部化学空间，并以更少的操作步骤达到相当或更高的初级活性，而REINVENT则探索了更广阔的化学空间。一个优化项目能否达成其目标取决于预测模型的质量，而非分子生成途径：达成度……（原文截断）
tldr: 该研究开发了开源模块化药物研发智能体MAGI，并在三家制药公司的九项真实先导化合物优化项目中验证，发现无论由大语言模型直接生成分子还是委托REINVENT 4生成，项目成败的关键在于预测模型的优劣，而非分子生成途径的选择。
en_tdlr: The open modular agent MAGI, evaluated on nine real-world lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, shows that campaign success depends on the quality of the predictive models rather than on whether molecules are generated directly by an LLM or delegated to REINVENT 4.
